reason: The estimate is stable when I re-ran it. With pre-period controls only, or with all pre-period covariates, the coefficient is about 0.69 (p<0.005), and it is 0.61 with the report's 1% outcome trim. The report correctly leaves out the post-treatment buyer_rating_2023, which would flip the sign if included. The conclusion of a positive effect is supported, though the causal reading rests on controlling for observables.
